name: Cedar Glacier
tagline: The operating system for the temperature revolution.
positioning: Cedar Glacier is the software backbone for cold-plunge studios — bookings, water intelligence, and membership billing in one calm command center.

hero.h1: Run the cold like you own the weather.
hero.sub: Cedar Glacier turns the chaos of managing a plunge studio — no-shows, water swaps, unpaid memberships — into one quiet, exact dashboard. This is infrastructure for the recovery era.

features.title: Plunge-Aware Booking
features.description: Sell timed immersion slots by tub and temperature. Cedar Glacier holds capacity, staggers entries, and kills double-bookings before your front desk ever sees them.

features.title: Water Intelligence
features.description: Log chill cycles, filtration, and sanitation against every plunge. When an inspector asks for the record, you hand over a timestamped ledger, not a clipboard.

features.title: Membership Billing
features.description: Recurring plans, class packs, and freeze requests bill themselves. Failed cards recover automatically so revenue stops leaking on the 3rd of the month.

features.title: Temperature Presets
features.description: Save protocols — 39°F contrast, 50°F intro, guided breath sets — and assign them to sessions so every operator runs the exact same experience.

features.title: Front-Desk Command
features.description: Check-ins, waivers, and towel counts on one screen. New staff learn the whole opening ritual in a single shift, not a single quarter.

features.title: Studio Analytics
features.description: See utilization per tub, peak plunge hours, and member retention curves. Decide when to add capacity with numbers instead of a hunch.

testimonials.quote: We were managing four tubs on a whiteboard and losing sixty bookings a week to overlap. Cedar Glacier gave us the utilization data to open a second room — it paid for itself in a month.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The water ledger alone is worth it. Our health inspector actually complimented the sanitation records. I have never once been complimented by an inspector before Cedar Glacier.
testimonials.name: Derek Halloran

testimonials.quote: Membership recovery quietly clawed back eleven hundred dollars in the first billing cycle. My front desk stopped chasing cards and started running the floor.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
